Aplicaciones · Herramientas web y experi: Applications · Web tools and 2D and 3D experiences · ONTOS
Desarrollo a medida: herramientas como e: Custom development: tools such as the PDF editor, 2D games, animated characters and 3D tours in your browser. Try ONTOS tools and experiences.
Herramientas que resuelven. Experiencias: Tools that solve problems. Experiences to explore.
Software a medida, juegos 2D, animación: Custom software, 2D games, animation and 3D tours. From a PDF editor to a character with a life of its own.
Some ideas need a tool. Others need a character, a game or a world to step into. I design and build these pieces to work in the browser.
De un documento a una casa en 3D: From a document to a house in 3D
Abre el editor, juega con ONTOS, recorre: Open the editor, play with ONTOS, walk its little world, look at a house rebuilt from a drone flight or a painter's website. You can try everything in your browser.
Editor PDF con un documento de ejemplo d: PDF editor with a three-page sample document
Aplicaciones a medida para trabajar con: Custom applications for working with documents, organising information and automating repetitive tasks.
<strong>Ya construido: editor PDF.</stro: Already built: PDF editor. Merge, rotate and reorder pages; turn photos of paper sheets into documents. Files are processed in your browser.
ONTOS como personaje en su juego 2D: ONTOS as a character in its 2D game
Una marca con la que jugar: A brand you can play with
Personajes animados y escenas interactiv: Animated characters and interactive scenes to explore an idea, introduce a brand or learn through play.
<strong>Ya construido: el juego 2D de ON: Already built: the ONTOS 2D game. The character steps out of the visual identity to become the protagonist of a scene you can interact with.
Un personaje que cobra vida: A character that comes to life
Volumen, poses y movimiento para dar exp: Volume, poses and movement to give a character expression or present a product from different angles.
<strong>Ya construido: ONTOS saludando.<: Already built: ONTOS waving. The character evolves into a 3D figurine you can inspect, rotate and zoom in on.
Escenas navegables para recorrer un espa: Navigable scenes to walk through a space, discover a brand environment or explore a presentation from within.
<strong>Ya construido: el pequeño mundo: Already built: the small world of ONTOS. A small planet with walking, sparkles and a seed to discover.
La misma casa en dos versiones: escanead: The same house in two versions: textured scan and simple geometry
De un vuelo a un modelo: From a flight to a model
Fotogrametría con dron para tener una ca: Drone photogrammetry to get a house, a warehouse or a plot in 3D: the textured scan and a simple geometry you can work with.
<strong>Ya construido: una casa de conte: Already built: a shipping-container house. A 26-second drone orbit and, processed locally, the exterior reconstructed and rectified container by container.
Ver el proceso y el resultado ▸: See the process and the result ▸
Portada de la web del pintor José María: Home page of painter José María Casado's website
Una web que el cliente puede mantener: A website the client can maintain
Páginas para enseñar un trabajo o una ob: Pages to show a body of work, with whatever it takes for the owner to update them without depending on anyone.
<strong>Ya construido: la galería de Jos: Already built: the gallery of painter José María Casado. His website turned into a gallery with a database of works he edits himself: collections, artwork sheets and featured pieces on the home page.
Ropa colgada en baldas ordenadas por col: Clothes hung on shelves sorted by colour: whites, greys, blacks
Tu ropa, fichada y colgada en baldas: Your clothes, catalogued and hung on shelves
Una foto por prenda y una ficha. El arma: One photo per garment and a record. The wardrobe sorts itself by colour or by type, tells you what you wear and what you don't, and suggests outfits you can see on yourself. All on your phone.
<strong>En uso: mi armario, 82 prendas.<: In use: my wardrobe, 82 garments. Try arranging ten garments by colour or by type and watch the real wardrobe on video.
¿Qué te gustaría construir?: What would you like to build?
Cuéntame para quién es, qué debería perm: Tell me who it is for, what it should let people do and where you would like to use it. If it is still a rough idea, we can start there.
